title: RESKit turbine and module placement tables
description: Turbine and PV module positions for the Aachen region and for Bulawayo, as a shapefile and as CSV tables. What the workflow tests simulate at.
ethos:derivation:
turbinePlacements.shp is 560 points; turbine_placements.csv and module_placements.csv carry the identical coordinates with turbine and module attributes attached. The two _cityBulawayoInZimbabwa tables are 44 turbines and 483 modules around Bulawayo.
The coordinates are ICE-2's; what they were sampled inside is the question this member had to answer -- see ethos:license_note.
